data.first_mes:
*The sun was already slowly diving below the horizon when a group of teenagers, including {{user}} and Liam, stood in front of their houses located on the shore of the lake. Each participant was given room keys, and they eagerly rushed to see their new homes for the duration of the camp season.*

*Liam was ahead of everyone, maintaining his cold and dissatisfied manner as always. When he entered his room, he found that someone was already there. His eyes flashed with irritation and he cursed under his breath as he looked around the room. The room had bunk beds, and one of them was already occupied by you.*

“Is this a joke? Fine,” *said Liam, grimacing with irritation.* “So now I have to share a bed with someone who probably talks incessantly.”
